tasks.short: Provide family counselling in substance abuse programmes

steps.what: Provide family counseling and treatment services to inmates in substance abuse programs

tasks.design: Keep therapeutic interaction with the therapist, referencing the treatment framework in {DOCS}. Check native document access if retrieval is separately burdensome; recording tools do not establish a reduction in family counselling itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment depends on therapeutic judgement, trust and family relationships.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital reference access supports care without replacing the encounter.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding conflicting perspectives and responding to emerging therapeutic concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Presence, trust and skilled interpretation of the family interaction.
tasks.altitude: Therapeutic responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss family context in treatment coordination

evidence.claim: Attendi supports dictation into care records; that documentation capability does not establish replacement of counselling or treatment interaction.

assumptions: Boundary is the therapist's counselling and treatment encounter, excluding separate documentation, institutional scheduling and other professionals' care work.
Participants provide concerns during s1 and therapist interprets them there. No machine assumes a free risk classification, treatment recommendation or structured family assessment.
Native reference access is checked first if a distinct retrieval issue is found.
No new application or recording requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is any observed clerical work distinct from the therapeutic encounter?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Counselling remains human; separate documentation savings are not imported.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide public education and professional consultation

steps.what: Clarify audience needs and select reliable counseling information for education
Prepare educational explanations and materials on counseling services, issues and methods

loop.purpose: Draft audience-appropriate education from supplied references
loop.input: Checked education brief and current public source packet
loop.output: Cited draft explanations with uncertainties and service limits
loop.check: Therapist verifies every claim, meaning, audience suitability and distinction between general education and individual advice
loop.stop: One draft and revision; misleading or unsupported material is rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining counselling methods for varied audiences needs language judgement

steps.what: Review educational materials and provide education and consultation to groups or professionals

tasks.design: Test native drafting in {DOCS} for a small source-grounded education draft. The therapist checks the exact material before delivery and keeps all live education, consultation and audience-response time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing clear wording for recurring topics takes time alongside delivery.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can adapt supplied educational references for an audience.
tasks.still_hard: Questions may reveal needs that prepared material does not address.
tasks.human_edge: Reading the audience and explaining difficult concepts responsibly.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less preparation wording; consultation responsibility remains human.

reach.task: Review audience suitability of a session

evidence.claim: Source-bounded public education drafting is plausible; the supplied case-note products do not establish savings for educational material preparation.

assumptions: Boundary includes therapist preparation and delivery only; audience attendance and other professional decisions retain their own time.

Therapist in s1 selects sources and records source IDs/pages, current service facts, audience, purpose and session scope. Gathering and capture retain all s1 time; missing information is clarified manually before drafting.
Use public or permitted general references without client case details. Audience questions arise during s3, not as free advance structured input.
Native templates and drafting are checked first; already prepared reusable material earns no additional saving.
research_questions: Does a draft save preparation time after meaning checks and audience adaptation?

already_counted.description: Source capture, draft verification, final review and live delivery

approvals.approved_version: Exact educational material version, source references, audience and service statements; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+20*0.70+60=94, gross=6, focal upkeep=4, net=2. Range 0-1 assumes recurring wording preparation; substantial audience adaptation or existing materials remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Follow up counselling results and programme effectiveness

steps.what: Follow up clients' adjustments and gather counseling program outcome information
Compile program results and calculate descriptive outcome summaries
Determine program effectiveness using outcomes, client context and uncertainty

tasks.design: Configure a descriptive summary in {BI} from outcome data captured and checked during follow-up in {OTHER}, the care record system. Keep client contact and effectiveness judgement human; numerical trends do not establish treatment causality.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated outcome tallies can interrupt interpretation and follow-up.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed summaries can calculate explicit measures with visible missingness.
tasks.still_hard: Attrition, different client needs and other influences limit causal interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding individual adjustment and challenging misleading programme comparisons.
tasks.altitude: Less manual tallying; clinical and programme interpretation remain human.

reach.learn: Denominators, missingness and descriptive versus causal claims

evidence.claim: Configured summaries of checked outcome records are plausible; the supplied administrative reporting examples do not establish clinical programme effectiveness.

assumptions: Boundary includes therapist follow-up, descriptive compilation and assessment; no automated treatment or eligibility decisions are proposed.

Therapist in s1 obtains responses and captures pseudonymous client/episode ID, programme ID, measure/version, observation date, baseline and follow-up value, units, inclusion status and explicit missingness. Capture, clarification and consent/access checking retain all 40 hours; no free outcome completeness or improvement flag is assumed.

Fixed rules in the configured report produce counts, denominators and changes from those entries. Unmatched measures, missing baseline or doubtful identity return to manual review; they are not imputed.
Native outcome reporting is tested first. Other professionals' data provision remains ordinary work; extra data support is counted below.
unknowns: Existing outcome measures and native reporting
research_questions: Do descriptive summaries save tallying time after capture, missing-data handling and review?

already_counted.description: Client follow-up, data capture and effectiveness interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain measure mappings and denominator checks
Care record access and reporting support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+0+40=80, gross=20, focal upkeep=8, net=12. Range 0-3 assumes repeated manual tallies with comparable measures; existing reports or extensive missing data remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Write evaluations of parents and children from the assessed evidence for court use
Review evaluations for accuracy and provide testimony in court when required

tasks.design: Keep evaluative reasoning, report wording and testimony with the therapist, using evidence in {DOCS}. Check native reference navigation first; generic case-note drafting evidence does not establish a reliable saving for evaluative court opinions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The evaluation must distinguish observed facts, reported accounts and professional inference.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools aid access but do not replace evaluative accountability.
tasks.still_hard: Weighing conflicting accounts and explaining the limits of conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Defensible professional reasoning and responding to court questions.
tasks.altitude: Evaluation and testimony responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss the provenance of assessment evidence

evidence.claim: The supplied documentation cases do not establish equivalent professional reasoning or labour savings for custody-related court evaluations and testimony.

assumptions: Boundary covers evaluation writing, checking and testimony where requested, excluding separate assessment encounters and the court's decision-making time.

Therapist obtains assessment evidence in separate existing work before s1 and checks provenance while writing. Court questions arise during s2; no machine assumes a ready credibility rating or structured custody recommendation.
Native reference navigation is the first option if retrieval becomes a distinct burden.
No new tool or capture obligation means zero incremental upkeep; no clerical boilerplate share is invented.
unknowns: Time spent on purely repetitive report formatting
research_questions: Is there a separately observed formatting task that can change without altering evaluative reasoning?

incremental.description: No new upkeep or transferred work

approvals.approved_version: Exact evaluation version, evidence references, scope and recipient court; edits void report approval, and therapist remains responsible for each live answer

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Evaluative reasoning and testimony retain all time; outside court labour is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains therapeutic and evaluative responsibility while testing small education-draft and outcome-tally aids.
reach: Discuss programme evidence and provenance clearly with education and social-work colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A therapist who preserves therapeutic attention and makes programme claims easier to assess.
